findings.title: Duplicate `add_user_groups` migrations
findings.note: Reaffirms pilot DATA-P2-001; both files still present at a62e44a.
findings.impact: Ambiguous migration history; re-runs can diverge.
findings.recommendation: Squash/drop one migration and add an order/duplicate gate.

findings.title: `gdpr_delete_user` is a hard multi-table delete with partial coverage
findings.note: Reaffirms original DATA-P2-005; not re-verified line-by-line (partial).
findings.recommendation: Cover every FK table or use ON DELETE CASCADE with a documented retention matrix.

findings.title: Deploy workflows seeded production with test users (fixed)
findings.note: Deploy no longer seeds; capability remains only in the disabled seed workflow.

findings.title: Rollback scripts were only proven to exist (fixed)
findings.note: validate.yml now executes downs in reverse and re-applies ups.

report:
Reviewed all 78 migrations and
76 rollback scripts; the migration up/down/up gate now executes downs in
reverse. Two schema defects remain: duplicate `add_user_groups` migrations and
the hard multi-table `gdpr_delete_user`.
